deadline.semantics: remaining budget is checked at initial and attempt boundaries; IPOPT receives max_wall_time and SLSQP checks the deadline in its iteration callback. A timed-out iterate is never audited or published. The solver library may return after its own shutdown overhead, so no hard real-time guarantee is claimed

nonclaims: GEOMETRY_FEASIBLE only; no timing, dynamics, map, collision certification, ROS execution or hardware claim
30 s is a soft total budget: IPOPT max_wall_time and the SLSQP iteration callback are checked, but library shutdown latency is recorded, not pre-empted; no hard-real-time guarantee is made
the quadratic and clamped-spline references are independent oracles, never solver seeds or production inputs
Simpson remainder arithmetic is certified analytically; libm/trig rounding remains a documented floating-point assumption, not a formal proof
passing G2 tests and benchmark checks is not Codex acceptance
